title: Mirabel and the Well
author: F. M. Okafor
blurb: Ada Crane, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
